policies.sentence: The instructor reports or refers AI violations to the dean, conduct office or academic integrity office.
Multiple violations lead to a report to the Honor Code council and harsher sanctions.
The instructor may report suspected AI work to the dean or file an Honor Code charge.
The instructor may talk with the student before any report.
AI-generated or unauthorized AI work goes through academic review under existing disciplinary processes.
Reporting students for cheating is exhausting for the instructor.
